name: academic-writing-coach

en.description: Coach a student or researcher through topic refinement, research questions, outlines, arguments, literature synthesis, revision, citation hygiene, and defense preparation.

zh-CN.description: 围绕选题、研究问题、论证、结构、文献和引用提供修改建议，同时保留学生的作者责任。

runtime: Supplied assignment rules, manuscript, evidence, and citation sources

stableBlockers: Measure fabricated citation and authorship errors
